method: Compact record of actual failures and fixes; source-log hashes identify temporary originals, not dependencies needed to run the game. Final gates retained separately.

findings.finding: Low-effects global 50ms transition interpolated floating tooltip left/top between mousedown and mouseup; some clicks landed on tooltip/BODY.
findings.change: Explicit no-transition for tooltip/menu; pointer-down suppresses focus tooltip; bounded floating placement.

findings.finding: Shift range shrank incorrectly; clear followed by Shift could revive earlier outside-range selections.
findings.change: Stable anchor/base/direction; clear/undo/target-remove reset selection range; focus updates roving tabindex.
findings.evidence: fusion-browser-range.json: keyboard group 11 checks, plus final frozen replay

findings.finding: Initial 1440 pool showed only 18 complete cards; narrow footer initially omitted six faces.
findings.change: Recovered vertical space; single responsive fixed dock contains six outcomes and XP; 3 relics show 18 exact levels.
findings.evidence: fusion-browser.json + PAGE_REVIEW.md; same visual markup after controller-only optimization
